# Bundled QR encoder

`qrcodegen.py` is the unmodified Python encoder from Project Nayuki's
[QR Code generator v1.8.0](https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/blob/v1.8.0/python/qrcodegen.py).
It uses only the Python standard library. Its MIT license and copyright notice
are retained in the source file.
